sentences.text: This first application has been filed by applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.717 of 2023 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Ashok Nagar (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 409 of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Kotwali, District Ashok Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant is in judicial custody since 16-10-2023.

As per the case of prosecution, Rakesh Yadav, submitted a written complaint to SHO, PS Kotwali,
Ashok Nagar inter alia stating that Varun Doorvar (applicant) was working as Nodal Person with regard to payment of honorarium to the employees of Government Hostel.
Varun Doorvar has forged the note-sheet and sanction order with regard to payment of honorarium for the month of September, 2023 and transferred the amount of Rs.5,74,900/- into his own account.

On such allegations, PS Kotwali, Ashok Nagar registered FIR at Crime No.717 of 2023 for offence punishable Varun Doorvar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58432741/
1 under Sections 420, 409 of IPC against applicant.

sentences.text: Statements of witnesses were recorded.
Applicant was arrested on 16-10-2023, he is in custody ever since.
Relevant seizure has been made.
On completion of investigation, Final Report was submitted on 18-01- 2024.
Learned Counsel for the applicant, in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that applicant has been falsely implicated in this matter.
The honorarium was approved by the Higher Officials online.
The applicant was merely working as Computer Operator.
He has been made scapegoat in the transaction.
Learned Counsel further submits that applicant is aged 23 years.
No criminal antecedent is report reported against him.
There is no likelihood of his absconsion leaving his family, home and job.
There is no likelihood of his tampering with evidence as entire evidence is based on online transaction and documentary evidence.
Trial would take time to conclude.
Therefore, applicant may be extended the benefit of bail.
Per contra, learned Counsel for the State opposes the bail application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence and prays for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall circumstances of the case but without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.

Accordingly, it is directed that applicant -VARUN DOORVAR shall be released on bail in relation to Crime No. 717 of 2023 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Ashok Nagar (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 409 of IPC, upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.
